title: ppu.toys · finale
description: 128 sprites and the S-DSP build the logo: one firefly per note, a turning swarm, then every OAM entry finds its pixel and the logo lands on the downbeat. OAM, additive colour math (OBJ palettes 4-7 + sub screen), per-line backdrop/COLDATA gradient, mosaic resolve, and a score{} song source with echo.
